standard.summary: Newbie 适配器类型，会映射到原生 LoRA
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.lora: 标准 LoRA，兼容最好，参数大概 2·r·d。
optionDescriptions.lora_plus: LoRA+，A/B 学习率可以拆开；比设歪了一侧会学不动。
optionDescriptions.rs_lora: rsLoRA 缩放，rank 高时不那么容易数值炸。
optionDescriptions.lora_fa: LoRA-FA，冻住一部分，能训的参数更少。
optionDescriptions.vera: VeRA，文件特别小，难概念容易不够用。
optionDescriptions.tlora: lulynx 渐进秩 LoRA（历史 T-LoRA key），按全局训练进度改变有效 rank。
optionDescriptions.flexrank: 各层 rank 可以不一样。
optionDescriptions.gdlokr: GDLoKr，Kronecker + 幅度，表达强、实现重。
optionDescriptions.locon: 卷积也挂低秩，吃纹理，文件常更大。
optionDescriptions.loha: Hadamard 积，同预算表达常常比 LoRA 丰一点，也更贵。
optionDescriptions.lokr: Kronecker 分解，省参数；factor 走极端会难训。
optionDescriptions.ia3: 几乎只学通道缩放，文件最小。
optionDescriptions.dora: 方向加幅度，常比纯 LoRA 贴底，一步稍慢。（本选择器里没有：DoRA 走的是独立入口 network_module='networks.lora' + use_dora 开关，不是本字段的取值。）
optionDescriptions.oft: 正交约束着改，块和秩设错会学不动。
optionDescriptions.full: 几乎按全参那档上，最能改也最吃显存、最好过拟合。
optionDescriptions.hydralora: 多专家路由，路由不稳算力就白扔。（本选择器里没有：HydraLoRA 由独立开关 hydralora_enabled 驱动，配套 hydralora_num_experts / hydralora_top_k 等字段。）
optionDescriptions.lulynx_frozen_a_lora: 冻结 A 侧的 LoRA(LoRA-FA):A 侧固定不训,只训 B 侧,优化器状态更省。后端归一成 lora_fa。
optionDescriptions.lulynx_progressive_rank_lora: 渐进秩 LoRA:有效秩随训练进度按调度变化,早期低秩更稳;后端走 tlora 那条实现,不是论文 T-LoRA 的 timestep 调度。

standard_en.summary: Newbie adapter type; it maps onto the native LoRA.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

optionDescriptions.lora: Standard LoRA: the best compatibility, roughly 2*r*d parameters.
optionDescriptions.lora_plus: LoRA+, where the A and B learning rates can be split; set one side wrong and it stops learning.
optionDescriptions.rs_lora: rsLoRA scaling, less prone to numerical blow-ups at high rank.
optionDescriptions.lora_fa: LoRA-FA: part of it is frozen, so there are fewer trainable parameters.
optionDescriptions.vera: VeRA: very small files, but easily too weak for a difficult concept.
optionDescriptions.tlora: lulynx progressive-rank LoRA (historical T-LoRA key): the effective rank changes with global training progress.
optionDescriptions.flexrank: The rank may differ from layer to layer.
optionDescriptions.gdlokr: GDLoKr: Kronecker plus magnitude. Expressive, heavy to implement.
optionDescriptions.locon: Low-rank on the convolutions too: takes texture well, usually a larger file.
optionDescriptions.loha: Hadamard product: often richer than LoRA at the same budget, and more expensive.
optionDescriptions.lokr: Kronecker factorisation, parameter-thrifty; an extreme factor makes it hard to train.
optionDescriptions.ia3: Learns almost nothing but channel scales -- the smallest file.
optionDescriptions.dora: Direction plus magnitude, usually closer to the base than plain LoRA and slightly slower per step. (Not in this selector: DoRA goes through its own entry, network_module='networks.lora' plus the use_dora switch, not a value of this field.)
optionDescriptions.oft: Changes things under an orthogonality constraint; wrong block or rank settings and it will not learn.
optionDescriptions.diag-oft: The diagonal flavour of OFT, a little lighter.
optionDescriptions.full: Effectively the full-parameter tier: the most capable, the most VRAM-hungry, and the easiest to overfit.
optionDescriptions.hydralora: Multi-expert routing; unstable routing throws the compute away. (Not in this selector: HydraLoRA is driven by its own hydralora_enabled switch, with hydralora_num_experts / hydralora_top_k and friends.)
optionDescriptions.lulynx_frozen_a_lora: LoRA with the A side frozen (LoRA-FA): A stays fixed and untrained, only B trains, so the optimizer state is smaller. The backend normalises this to lora_fa.
optionDescriptions.lulynx_progressive_rank_lora: Progressive-rank LoRA: the effective rank follows a schedule over training progress, and the low-rank early phase is steadier. It runs on the tlora implementation, not the paper T-LoRA's timestep schedule.

advanced.principle: Newbie 适配器类型，会映射到原生 LoRA、LyCORIS 或对应扩展注入器。

advanced_en.principle: Newbie adapter type; maps to native LoRA, LyCORIS, or the corresponding extension injector.
